cases.name: main_full
cases.description: handoff, legit payment, blocked payment attack, legit email, blocked exfil email, unreceipted call

cases.name: main_suffix_anchored
cases.description: window entries[3..] anchored at hash(entry 2)

cases.name: orphan_receipt
cases.description: window starts at a receipt whose call is outside it

cases.name: executed_caveat_violation
cases.description: executor ran a call violating ArgOneOf

cases.name: executed_after_expiry
cases.description: receipt time (executor clock) after grant expiry; caller timestamp inside

cases.name: budget_exceeded
cases.description: third send_money beyond MaxCalls 2 executed anyway

cases.name: unjustified_refusal
cases.description: executed-error counts toward budget; then a valid call refused (BLOCKED, justified=false)

cases.name: grant_unknown
cases.description: chain references a grant not in the transcript

cases.name: grant_tampered
cases.description: leaf grant modified after signing

cases.name: grant_chain_fake_root
cases.description: chain starts at a grant not issued by the root

cases.name: grant_chain_skip
cases.description: agent self-issues a grant under the principal's grant

cases.name: subgrant_cannot_widen
cases.description: caveat-free self sub-grant: attack still unauthorized, legit call authorized

cases.name: executor_caveat
cases.description: send_money executed by the mail executor (Executor caveat requires bank)

cases.name: receipt_wrong_executor
cases.description: mail signs a receipt for a call addressed to bank

cases.name: duplicate_receipt
cases.description: two receipts for one call

cases.name: tamper_call_args
cases.description: bit flip inside signed tool-call args (still canonical)

cases.name: noncanonical_args
cases.description: tool-call args with unsorted keys

cases.name: receipt_bad_reason
cases.description: receipt status refused with reason 0

cases.name: tamper_receipt_sig
cases.description: bit flip in a receipt signature

cases.name: duplicate_grant
cases.description: same grant twice in the grants section

cases.name: tamper_grant_sig
cases.description: bit flip in g1's signature: every executed call becomes unauthorized

cases.name: grant_maxcalls_without_executor
cases.description: validly signed grant violating the MaxCalls/Executor rule

cases.name: v2_container_v1_only
cases.description: v2 container with no grants and only v1 manifests (non-canonical)

cases.name: v1_container_v2_entry
cases.description: v1 container holding a v2 manifest

cases.name: mixed_v1_v2_ok
cases.description: v2 container with grants mixing a v1 handoff and v2 entries

cases.name: revoked_then_refused
cases.description: issuer revokes g1; the gate refuses a later call with GRANT_REVOKED

cases.name: revoked_but_executed
cases.description: executor ignores a revocation that precedes its receipt

cases.name: revocation_outside_window
cases.description: same transcript, window starts after the revocation, so it is not applied

cases.name: revocation_not_retroactive
cases.description: a receipt before the revocation stays authorized; the call after it is refused

cases.name: unentitled_revokers_ignored
cases.description: the audience of g1 and the leaf holder cannot revoke g1 or g2

cases.name: ancestor_issuer_revokes_leaf
cases.description: the issuer of an ancestor grant (g1) may revoke the leaf g2

cases.name: expired_reported_before_revoked
cases.description: a call both expired and revoked reports GRANT_EXPIRED (step 4 before 4a)

cases.name: refused_revoked_without_revocation
cases.description: a GRANT_REVOKED refusal with no revocation in the transcript is unjustified
